posts.author: Overmind Zergalag
posts.title: Re: Killing floor tips.
posts.html:
I like shotguns...that's why I use the support perk.

The shotgun is actually quite accurate, and very powerful, kills goreblades in one shot (within a certain distance, like 50 ft or so).  Also, the shotgun is very cheap if you have the support perk.
